plain_statement: It is false that: A graph in which every vertex outside a set A has exactly three neighbours, A meets no edge, every cycle has length at least 7, and there is an edge; f is true when some input of A is on or both ends of an edge are on. If f has a circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates with s gates, then for some vertex v outside A, f with x_v fixed false has a circuit with at most s - 4 gates.
